disposition_reason: Original AAS measurements of lead and cadmium in 24 field-grown vegetable species; the main text prints only cross-species ranges and one species value, with per-species data in an unavailable supplement.

study.design: Field study of soils and 24 vegetable species harvested from the same fields in five districts
study.origin: vegetable fields in Hangu, Kohat, Bannu, Lakki Marwat and Dera Ismail Khan, Khyber Pakhtunkhwa, Pakistan; irrigated from Indus, Kurram and tube-wells
study.method: AAS (PerkinElmer AAS-700) after HNO3/HClO4 hot-plate digestion of oven-dried (65 °C, 72 h) edible parts
study.qa: Reference materials GBW-07406 (soil) and GBW-07602 (plant); recoveries Cd 101±4.5%, Pb 93±7.3%; triplicate analysis

findings.group: farm fields in Hangu, Kohat, Bannu, Lakki Marwat and DI Khan, Khyber Pakhtunkhwa
findings.notes: Lowest species mean. Text attributes the lowest Pb to A. sativum (garlic) but its ordered list ends with P. sativum (pea). Range of species mean concentrations printed in text; per-species values are in Supplementary Table S3, not available. Dried edible parts; basis dry per Methods.
